controles.affirmation: Gain de juste valeur de 828,6 M$ sur la participation de 43,4% dans Indicor, liee a la cession d'Indicor Instrumentation a AMETEK pour environ 5 Mds $ de valeur d'entreprise, soumise aux autorisations reglementaires et non close
controles.verbatim_source: As of June 30, 2026 ... the Company held a 43.4 % ... equity interest in Indicor Equity, LLC ; Changes in fair value 828.6 ; "Equity investment activity, net, was a gain of $835.2 in the second quarter of 2026 due primarily to an $828.6 increase in the fair value of our equity investment in Indicor" ; "On May 5, 2026, Indicor entered into a definitive agreement to divest its portfolio of instrumentation businesses ('Indicor Instrumentation') to AMETEK, Inc. for an enterprise value of approximately $5.0 billion. The transaction is subject to customary closing conditions, including applicable regulatory approvals, and is expected to close in the second half of 2026." (10-Q T2 2026)

controles.affirmation: Benefice net du T2 2026 de 1 168,5 M$ contre 378,3 M$, BPA dilue 11,62 $ (+233%)
Chiffre d'affaires total en hausse de 8,5% au T2 2026
controles.verbatim_source: Net revenues for the three months ended June 30, 2026 were $2,108.9 as compared to $1,943.6 for the three months ended June 30, 2025, an increase of 8.5%. (10-Q T2 2026)

controles.affirmation: Croissance organique du segment Application Software de 4,5% seulement
controles.verbatim_source: The growth of 4.5% in organic revenues was broad-based across the segment (10-Q T2 2026, Application Software)
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance : la croissance organique du groupe Roper est de 4,9% au T2 2026 (tableau des composantes de croissance).

controles.affirmation: Le solde de la croissance vient des acquisitions 2025 (CentralReach, Subsplash)
controles.verbatim_source: Application Software : "Growth from acquisitions was led by our 2025 acquisitions of CentralReach and Orchard Software." Network Software : "led by contributions from 2025 acquisitions, most notably Subsplash." (10-Q T2 2026)
controles.correction_proposee: Subsplash est une acquisition du segment Network Software, pas Application Software. Pour Application Software, citer CentralReach et Orchard Software.

controles.affirmation: Le carnet de commandes total progresse de 11,0% sur un an, porte en partie par les acquisitions
controles.verbatim_source: Backlog increased 11.0% to $3,286.0 at June 30, 2026 as compared to $2,961.3 at June 30, 2025 due primarily to acquisitions and organic growth in our software segments. (10-Q T2 2026)

controles.affirmation: La dette long terme hors part courante passe de 8 595,8 M$ a 10 601,1 M$ en six mois
controles.verbatim_source: Long-term debt, net of current portion 10,601.1 8,595.8 (10-Q T2 2026, bilan)

controles.affirmation: La charge d'interets nette du T2 quasiment double, a 111,4 M$ contre 79,1 M$
controles.verbatim_source: Interest expense, net, increased to $111.4 for the second quarter of 2026 as compared to $79.1 for the second quarter of 2025 due primarily to higher average debt balances and a higher weighted-average interest rate on our senior notes. (10-Q T2 2026)
controles.correction_proposee: Les montants sont exacts mais la hausse est de 41%, pas d'un doublement. Remplacer 'quasiment double' par 'progresse de 41%'.

controles.affirmation: La dette nette rapportee a l'EBITDA ajuste sur 12 mois glissants atteint 3,15x, en hausse de 28,8% sur un an
controles.verbatim_source: Aucune mention de ce ratio dans le 10-Q T2 2026. Source unique : kpis-haut/ROP.json, KPI NetDebtEBITDA, arrete au 31 mars 2026.
controles.correction_proposee: Ratio non publie par Roper et arrete au 31 mars 2026, soit un trimestre avant la periode de l'ATT. Soit le dater explicitement dans l'argument (et pas seulement dans le champ source), soit le recalculer au 30 juin 2026 (dette nette = 10 601,1 + 718,3 - 364,9 = 10 954,5 M$).

controles.affirmation: Sur le semestre, la tresorerie d'exploitation s'eleve a 1 061,6 M$, inferieure aux 2 750,8 M$ d'actions rachetees
controles.verbatim_source: Operating activities $ 1,061.6 / $ 932.8 (10-Q T2 2026) ; Common stock repurchased (2,750.8) sur six mois, dont (1,236.1) au T2 (etat des variations des capitaux propres)
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance omise : "Net cash provided by operating activities increased by 14% to $1,061.6". Par ailleurs le champ source renvoie a la 'note Stockholders Equity', qui indique un prix d'achat agrege de 2 724,1 M$ ; le 2 750,8 M$ provient de l'etat des variations des capitaux propres.

controles.affirmation: Goodwill 21 330,7 M$ et incorporels nets 9 347,3 M$, soit environ 87% des 35 169,5 M$ d'actifs totaux
controles.verbatim_source: Goodwill 21,330.7 21,341.2 ; Other intangible assets, net 9,347.3 9,764.2 ; Total assets $ 35,169.5 (10-Q T2 2026, bilan). 30 678,0 / 35 169,5 = 87,2%

controles.affirmation: Hors gain Indicor, le resultat d'exploitation du semestre ne progresse que de 7,5% (1 154,3 M$ contre 1 074,1 M$)
controles.verbatim_source: Income from operations ... 1,154.3 1,074.1 (10-Q T2 2026, six mois). +7,46%

controles.affirmation: Programme de rachat porte a 6 Mds $ apres un ajout de 3 Mds $ approuve en avril 2026
controles.verbatim_source: In October 2025, the Company's Board of Directors approved a share repurchase program authorizing the repurchase of up to $3,000.0 of the Company's common stock, and in April 2026 approved an additional $3,000.0 of repurchase authorization under the program. (10-Q T2 2026, note 6 Stockholders' Equity)

controles.affirmation: Le risque de cybersecurite est place en tete de la liste des facteurs de risque cites par la societe elle-meme
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025, Item 1A (data-lake/ROP/_risks_src_30k.txt) : "RISK FACTORS Risks Related to Our Business Operations Our growth strategy includes acquisitions. We may not be able to identify suitable acquisition candidates, complete acquisitions, or integrate acquisitions successfully." La cybersecurite n'apparait qu'apres plusieurs facteurs. La fiche v2-pipeline elle-meme note 'Position: bas Item 1A'.
controles.correction_proposee: Le premier facteur de risque du 10-K est la strategie d'acquisitions. Supprimer 'place en tete de la liste' ou remplacer par 'figure parmi les facteurs de risque cites par la societe'.

controles.affirmation: La societe cite explicitement sa dependance a des plateformes cloud et fournisseurs de technologies de l'information externes
controles.verbatim_source: If any third-party system or cloud platform that we use is unavailable to us for any reason, our customers may experience service interruptions, which could significantly impact our operations, reputation, business, and financial results. (10-K FY2025, Item 1A)
